description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within an OpenCart extension, responsible for calculating and adding tax total information to the cart totals. It contains a method for retrieving tax totals and updating the overall total amount.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: A class for calculating tax totals in the cart. It extends the core Opencart Model class and provides a method to accumulate tax information into the overall cart totals.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates tax totals, appends them to the totals array, and increases the total amount by the tax value.
